title.description: The destination, e.g. "Kerala". Shown on cards, and in the home carousel's corner tab when "place" is empty.

place.description: The town or places the trip was based in, e.g. "Alleppey and Fort Kochi". Shown in the home carousel's corner tab instead of the title. Optional.

from.patternErrorMessage: Write the date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-10-02.

to.description: Last day of the trip (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional: leave it empty for a one-day trip.

anyOf.patternErrorMessage: Write the date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-10-02.

dates.description: When the trip happened. Newer trips appear first everywhere.

summary.description: One or two sentences. Used on cards and in search results.

cover.patternErrorMessage: A photo file name such as backwaters-01.jpg
cover.description: The photo used on cards and at the top of the trip page.

video.description: A clip from videos/ that plays silently behind the trip title, e.g. backwaters-loop.mp4. Optional; 8 to 15 seconds works best.

anyOf.patternErrorMessage: A clip file name such as backwaters-loop.mp4

featured.description: Photos that may appear in the home-page carousel.

items.patternErrorMessage: A photo file name such as backwaters-01.jpg

photos.description: Captions and alt text, keyed by file name. Alt text is required for the cover and featured photos.

propertyNames.patternErrorMessage: A photo file name such as backwaters-01.jpg

caption.description: Shown under the photo in the lightbox. Optional.

alt.description: Describe the photo for people who cannot see it, as if telling a friend over the phone.

pinned.description: Photos shown first, in this order. The rest follow by capture time.

hidden.description: Photos kept but not shown on the site.
